entries.title: Donald Trump Jr and Bettina Trump say Putin ally paid for some wedding festivities as a 'gift'

entries.title: Turkish habit of stashing gold "under the pillow' hurts economy, government says
entries.snippet: For years, Turks have stashed their gold at home against a raining day, mistrustful of banks. Now the government says that tradition hurts the economy

entries.title: Turks often keep gold as a hedge against inflation. It may be hurting Turkey's future
entries.snippet: Billions of dollars worth of gold is held in Turkish households outside the banking system. The government aims to convince citizens to put it into the mainstream financial system to help the economy.

entries.title: State of U.S. democracy reaches new low, report finds
entries.snippet: A new global democracy report finds the U.S. at its lowest level of democratic performance in the 50 years it has been measured.

entries.title: Family income rose and poverty fell in 2025 — but safety net cuts could erase gains
entries.snippet: An annual report from the Census Bureau shows the average family made more money in 2025 than the year before, while the official poverty rate declined. Health care coverage was little changed from 2024.

entries.snippet: The board's vote to shutter the historic arts center came amid concerns about financial, structural problems.

entries.title: Prosecutors won't seek the death penalty for Nick Reiner
entries.snippet: Los Angeles County District Attorney Nathan Hochman said his office spoke with Reiner's siblings and took their wishes into consideration in the decision.

entries.title: Republican Rep. Massie moves to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth over Iran war
entries.snippet: Kentucky Republican Thomas Massie introduced articles of impeachment against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Tuesday over the war in Iran.

entries.title: Tiny krill are turning up in deep-sea hydrothermal vents. Scientists want to know why
entries.snippet: Antarctic krill serve as a crucial food source for penguins, seals, and whales. They recycle nutrients used by algae. Now researchers say they've found krill in a surprising place: hydrothermal vents.

entries.title: Geopolitics and grain don't mix, say these Montana farmers
entries.snippet: Farmers in states bordering Canada say they are reeling from President Trump's trade wars and resulting retaliatory tariffs. And it's just not neighborly.

entries.title: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
entries.snippet: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.

entries.snippet: Massie said Hegseth abused his powers by deploying the U.S. military in the war against Iran without seeking congressional approval under the War Powers Act. He said these are "unlawful orders" and "high crimes and misdemeanors."

entries.title: 18-year-old dies in Pennsylvania's 4th measles-associated death
entries.snippet: The U.S. is experiencing its worst measles year since 1991, with seven deaths in two years.

entries.title: WATCH LIVE: Warsh holds briefing after Fed meeting as interest rates expected to rise
entries.snippet: The Federal Reserve is widely expected to lift its short-term interest rate Wednesday for the first time in three years to fight stubbornly high inflation, a move that would put the central bank at odds with President Donald Trump's support for a cut.

entries.title: WATCH: Blumenthal grills FBI Director Kash Patel on firing Iran specialists days before U.S. launched war
entries.snippet: Sen. Richard Blumenthal, D-Conn., asked FBI Director Kash Patel why he fired a dozen agents and staff members from a counterintelligence unit "specifically tasked with monitoring threats with Iran," days before the U.S. launched an attack against the country.

entries.title: More artists drop out of Ed Sheeran's tour in solidarity with rapper Macklemore
entries.snippet: Irish acts Aaron Rowe and Beoga, Denmark's Lukas Graham, and Finneas posted separately on social media that they would withdraw from the tour.

entries.title: WATCH: Steve Bannon says 'we have to rise' above partisanship to address AI 'hinge in history'
entries.snippet: Longtime Trump ally Steve Bannon doesn't always align himself with Sen. Bernie Sanders, the democratic socialist from Vermont. But on Tuesday he said threats posed by artificial intelligence span political ideology.

entries.title: Congressional Black Caucus launches effort to boost voting among Black, rural and young voters in midterms
entries.snippet: Organizers say they hope to boost turnout and influence closely divided House districts by focusing on voters' best interests.

entries.title: Belarus' authoritarian leader Lukashenko meets U.S. envoy to push for lifting remaining sanctions
entries.snippet: Since President Donald Trump returned to the White House, Lukashenko has released hundreds of political prisoners in a series of U.S.-mediated deals that also lifted some U.S. sanctions.

entries.title: WATCH: Patel grilled on whether he'll send FBI agents to the polls in November

entries.title: WATCH: Blanche justifies Trump bashing Supreme Court over mail ballots: 'He is very frustrated'
entries.snippet: Attorney General Todd Blanche said Tuesday it was proper for President Donald Trump to vent about the Supreme Court decision to decline the changes that the president wanted for mail-in voting.

entries.title: WATCH: Patel explains why FBI no longer considers bestiality an automatic hiring disqualifier
entries.snippet: Patel said the change allows applications from people who have been victims of these crimes to be considered.

entries.title: Nick Reiner will not face death penalty over his parents' killings

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: AI leaders call for regulations, Trump dismisses 'hoaxes'
entries.snippet: AI giants are working to create a standards body amid rising alarms about the dangers of the industry. Meanwhile, Trump has dismissed the warnings, and a divided US Congress has failed to act.

entries.title: Criticism of LGBTQ+ raids in Turkey is growing
entries.snippet: Several raids and arrests of LGBTQ+ persons in Turkey have triggered sharp criticism from numerous Turkish organizations — and also from Brussels.

entries.title: High fuel prices challenge the German government
entries.snippet: Chancellor Friedrich Merz wants to provide relief to motorists. But exactly how this is to happen remains unclear.

entries.title: Knobloch: 'It is a very dangerous situation at the moment'
entries.snippet: Charlotte Knobloch survived the Holocaust by passing as the daughter of non-Jewish farmers. She recently spoke with DW to express her shock following the AfD victory in Saxony-Anhalt's state election.

entries.title: South Africa now probing deaths of 8 women near Johannesburg
entries.snippet: Police have warned women to take extra care in parts of Johannesburg as similarities between at least eight deaths fuel fears that the cases could be connected.

entries.title: Why do authoritarian regimes target the LGBTQ+ community?
entries.snippet: A recent crackdown on the LGBTQ+ community in Turkey is symptomatic of a wider rights regression, according to experts. It's worse under authoritarian regimes, but why is it such a popular policy for these states?

entries.title: Russia: Trump's Ukraine ceasefire proposal is 'good idea'
entries.snippet: The Kremlin has hailed an "energy ceasefire" proposed by US President Trump, but has criticized a French initiative to share its nuclear deterrent. Meanwhile, hostilities have continued on the ground and in the air.

entries.title: Ovechkin still backing Putin party in parliamentary vote
entries.snippet: Ice hockey legend Alexander Ovechkin has lent Vladimir Putin's party a helping hand in its parliamentary election campaign. That's in keeping with a pattern of support by an athlete who claims not to be political.

entries.title: Spanish scientists find first evidence of Diplodocus dinosaur in Europe
entries.snippet: Paleontologists in Spain say they have found the first evidence of the long-necked Diplodocus genus of dinosaur outside of North America. They found bones at the rich La Tejeria fossil site in Teruel in eastern Spain.

entries.title: Saudi Arabia faces hard choices as Houthis gain in Yemen
entries.snippet: Saudi Arabia faces growing security and economic problems as it seeks to balance deterrence and diplomacy during its escalating conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis in neighboring Yemen.

entries.title: Why the era of cheap government debt is over
entries.snippet: US debt has topped $40 trillion. How risky is the country's growing debt burden. And will investors keep funding Washington's deficits?

entries.title: US allies in Asia alarmed as think tank calls for pullback
entries.snippet: Analysts warn that a US withdrawal from the western Pacific, as recently suggested by a think tank, would weaken deterrence and strengthen China's position.

entries.title: 'Woman, Life, Freedom' spirit lives on as Iran war drags on
entries.snippet: The 2022 death of Jina Mahsa Amini in police custody triggered a resistance movement in Iran. Four years later, the Iranian regime endures — but so does the legacy of the "Woman, Life, Freedom" protests.

entries.title: Bangladesh court sentences 7 Hasina allies to death
entries.snippet: The latest verdict brings to 22 the number of death sentences handed down in cases stemming from the 2024 uprising that ended Sheikh Hasina's 15-year rule.

entries.title: Socialist Left leads far-right AfD ahead of Berlin vote
entries.snippet: The results of the Berlin election are as hard to predict as ever. Three parties are vying for first place, including the socialist Left Party and the far-right AfD. But one issue is most important to Berliners.

entries.title: Germany news: Merz to cancel UN trip amid party infighting
entries.snippet: Germany's chancellor nixxed his trip over doubts about his leadership after party losses to the AfD in state elections. Meanwhile, Defense Minister Pistorius is in Washington for talks with his US counterpart. Follow DW.

entries.title: SPD governor campaigns as one-woman bulwark against AfD
entries.snippet: Manuela Schwesig, of the center-left SPD, has governed the state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, on the Baltic Sea coast, since 2017. Ahead of this weekend's election, she is campaigning against the nationalist AfD.

entries.title: US confirms it has weapons in space
entries.snippet: The Space Force justified the weapons deployment by citing the US's two biggest geopolitical rivals: Russia and China. Beijing responded by urging Washington to "stop preparing for war" in outer space.

entries.title: NATO jets shoot down drone over Lithuania
entries.snippet: The drone, which is believed to have entered Lithuanian airspace from Belarus, was shot down by an Italian fighter jet in between the cities of Vilnius and Kaunas. There have been no reports of casualties or damage.
